items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Not spotted Thursday
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt (undisclosed) wasn't present for the portion of Thursday's practice open to the media, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

items.title: Jalen Hurts: Out Week 6 due to blood clot on calf
items.text:
The Eagles have ruled Hurts out for Sunday's game against the Panthers after a follow-up ultrasound performed on his calf Wednesday revealed movement in a small blood clot, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Works off to the side Thursday

items.title: Jordan Mason: Eyeing return in Week 7
items.text:
The Vikings are hopeful that Mason (thumb) will be ready to return from injured reserve for their Week 7 game versus the Colts, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
